jobs.title: Director of Engineering
jobs.description:
Provides strategic and operational leadership for the Mikros Technologies Engineering organization, guiding the development of new technologies and products from concept through commercialization while ensuring the long-term performance and support of released products. Leads a strong team of seasoned engineering leaders of our multidisciplinary engineering teams responsible for New Product Design, Product Deployment, Advanced Technology Development, and future Sustaining Engineering, and Engineering Services Groups. Establishes engineering processes, technical standards, and organizational capabilities that enable innovation, product quality, operational excellence, and scalable business growth. Partners closely with Product Management, Factory Enablement, Site Operations, Supply Chain, Quality, and Sales to align engineering execution with business objectives and customer needs while developing engineering leaders and fostering a strong culture of teamwork that values technical excellence, innovation, quality, accountability, and customer focus.

What will you do?

Strategic Leadership

Develop and execute the engineering strategy aligned with company goals and growth initiatives.
Establish engineering priorities, goals, and performance metrics.
Guide Engineering Organizational Growth and Product Development Efficiency
Drive innovation and adoption of new technologies, tools, and methodologies.
Support long-term business planning, investment decisions, and organizational growth.

Engineering Management

Lead, mentor, and develop engineering managers, technical leads, and engineering staff.
Build and maintain a high-performing engineering organization focused on collaboration, accountability, engagement, and continuous learning.
Oversee workforce planning, recruitment, retention, succession planning, and talent development initiatives.
Ensure effective allocation of engineering resources across programs and projects.

Product & Program Execution

Oversee engineering support throughout the product lifecycle, from concept through prototype, production and sustainment.
Ensure engineering deliverables meet technical, schedule, cost, quality, and customer requirements.
Collaborate with Program Management to identify and mitigate technical and execution risks.
Support proposal development, customer engagements, and technical reviews as needed.

Operational Excellence

Establish and standardize engineering processes, procedures, and best practices.
Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on efficiency, quality, innovation, and cost reduction.
Develop and monitor key engineering performance indicators and implement corrective actions when necessary.
Ensure compliance with applicable industry standards, customer requirements, and regulatory obligations.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner with manufacturing, operations, quality, supply chain, and business development teams to achieve organizational objectives.
Build strong relationships with customers and external stakeholders.
Communicate engineering performance, risks, and opportunities to executive leadership.

Financial Management

Develop and manage departmental budgets and capital expenditure plans.
Monitor engineering costs and resource utilization.
Support business cases for investments in technology, equipment, and personnel.

How will you get here?

Education And Experience

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or related technical field required.
Master's degree in Engineering, Technology Management, or Business Administration preferred.
Minimum 10 years of progressive engineering experience.
Minimum 5 years of leadership experience managing engineering teams.
Experience leading engineering organizations within hardware manufacturing, technology, defense, or industrial environments, with materials or metallurgy experience preferred.
Proven track record of delivering complex programs and organizational results, with a priority on team development.
Or a combination of education, experience and/or training.

Required Skills And Abilities

Strong technical leadership and engineering management experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary engineering teams.
Experience managing complex projects, programs, and product development efforts.
Strong financial acumen, including budgeting and resource planning.
Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
Proven ability to drive organizational change and continuous improvement.
Strong problem-solving, decision-making, and strategic thinking capabilities.
Ability to build collaborative relationships across all levels of the organization.
Experience working in regulated, manufacturing, defense, aerospace, or technology environments preferred.

Key Success Measures

Achievement of engineering delivery commitments (performance, schedule, quality and cost).
Employee engagement, retention, and development within the engineering organization.
Successful execution of strategic engineering initiatives.
Successful collaboration with management teams across the organization.
Continuous improvement in productivity, quality, and operational performance.
Customer satisfaction and technical excellence.
Effective resource utilization and budget management.
Expert in the engineering discipline and systems which support functional processes.
Ability to think strategically and develop vision and roadmap for the technical group.
Proven track record in driving and implementing change to organizations.
Excellent interpersonal and communications skills.
Or a combination of education, experience and/or training.

Current is a $1.5B valuation Series E consumer fintech platform in NYC building a proprietary core banking system to improve financial outcomes for over 6 million members.

Job Description

As Director of Analytics Engineering at Current, you will be the strategic architect and hands-on leader of our data transformation layer. You will define the vision for our BigQuery data warehouse, lead a high-performing team of analytics engineers, and partner with stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable data models that power critical fintech insights.

jobs.title: Re:CAM - Vice President of Engineering
jobs.description:
About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

We hire builders. If you need a fully-scoped plan before you'll move, this isn't the role. We need leaders who turn ambiguity into action, stay close to the work, and build the systems that make scale possible — fast.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles )

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to own the development, launch, and scale-up of a new venture-scale opportunity in the CAM space. The right candidate will have demonstrated experience commercializing novel technology coming out of a research group, end-to-end. You are startup oriented, with experience shipping MVPs and then scaling them to thousands of users. The ideal candidate will have experience or strong familiarity with CAD/CAM space or in a tangential field using 3D modeling, simulation, and spatial data. You have excellent communication and conflict resolution skills. You are hungry and willing to roll up the sleeves and build with a talented cross-functional team.

What You Get To Do

Define the technology architecture required to bring a novel CAM product to market
Develop and implement a technology transfer strategy, from R&D to final product
Manage all elements of the software development process
Directly manage a team of software development engineers
Work closely with stakeholders to align product vision and commercial targets with an engineered solution
Partner with the GM and executive stakeholders to build a new venture-scale business

What You Bring To The Team

15+ years leading the development of highly technical engineered software products
A master's degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong full stack fundamentals (you can meaningfully review a hard MR)
Bonus points for some familiarity with C++
Advanced knowledge of modern architecture and trends
Advanced knowledge of AI tooling, applications, and trends
Ability to lead, grow and motivate a team
Excellent executive communication and conflict resolution skills
Prior experience in CAD/CAM or a related 3D space
Strong desire to build a venture scale business with a small team over the next several years

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason.

Re:Build is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Sr. Director, Cloud and Infrastructure Transformation
jobs.description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

At the heart of Pfizer's Digital transformation sits Infrastructure & Cloud, enabling modern cloud platforms and engineering capabilities that accelerate scientific discovery, empower researchers, and improve patient outcomes worldwide.

Pfizer is seeking a highly accomplished technology leader who combines enterprise-scale strategic thinking with deep technical expertise in cloud, infrastructure, networking, and platform engineering. This role will shape the future of Pfizer's cloud and infrastructure ecosystem, enabling AI/ML-powered research, advanced analytics, and next-generation digital capabilities that support breakthrough science and drug discovery.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business strategy with executive leadership, guiding large-scale transformation initiatives, and engaging directly with architects and engineers on critical technical decisions. This is a leadership role for someone who has not only led transformation programs but has personally helped design, build, and scale modern cloud platforms and infrastructure capabilities.

At Pfizer, your work will directly contribute to the technologies that enable scientists to accelerate research, unlock insights from complex data, and develop innovative medicines for patients around the world.

Pfizer seeks individuals who are highly self-motivated, intellectually curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning and growth.

What You Will Achieve

The Senior Director, Cloud & Infrastructure Transformation serves as both a strategic technology executive and a technical thought leader for Pfizer's cloud and infrastructure landscape. This leader will define future-state infrastructure strategy while ensuring the successful execution of complex, enterprise-scale initiatives spanning cloud, networking, data center modernization, platform engineering, and AI infrastructure.

You will lead a team of senior leaders, architects, and engineering organizations while helping establish the technology vision, engineering standards, and operating models required to support Pfizer's digital future.

You will be expected to drive business outcomes through technology strategy while maintaining the technical depth and credibility necessary to guide architecture decisions, challenge assumptions, and ensure engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute Pfizer's multi-year cloud and infrastructure transformation strategy, aligning technology investments with business and scientific priorities.
Lead enterprise-wide modernization initiatives spanning multi-cloud environments, AI/ML platforms, network transformation, infrastructure automation, and data center evolution.
Serve as a senior technical authority, providing guidance on architecture, platform engineering, cloud operations, resiliency, security, and infrastructure modernization.
Partner with architects and engineering leaders to evaluate and influence critical technology decisions, ensuring scalable, secure, and operationally resilient solutions.
Drive adoption of cloud-native architectures, Infrastructure as Code, automation, observability, DevOps, and Site Reliability Engineering practices.
Establish technology roadmaps and engineering standards that support innovation, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.
Build strong partnerships across Digital, Security, Research, and Business organizations to accelerate enterprise transformation initiatives.
Lead and develop high-performing teams of Directors, Senior Managers, and technical leaders while cultivating a culture of innovation, accountability, and technical excellence. Mainly influencing to start, followed by a larger team over time.
Influence senior executive stakeholders and drive alignment across a complex, global, matrixed organization.
Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends to identify opportunities that improve Pfizer's technology capabilities and business outcomes.
Balance strategic priorities, execution risks, operational demands, and technical considerations to drive sustainable transformation at scale.

Leadership Expectations

Candidates should demonstrate a breadth of leadership experiences and capabilities, including:

Influencing executive leaders, peers, and technical teams to achieve enterprise outcomes.
Building organizational capability and developing future technology leaders.
Creating an environment that promotes innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
Leading through ambiguity and driving execution in highly complex environments.
Translating technology strategy into measurable business impact.
Establishing credibility with both senior executives and highly technical engineering teams.

Here Is What You Need (Minimum Requirements)

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
12+ years of progressive leadership experience in cloud, infrastructure, networking, platform engineering, or related technology functions.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale cloud and infrastructure transformation programs at enterprise scale.
Deep expertise in public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), with a proven history of designing, building, and operating production environments supporting critical business workloads.
Strong technical foundation spanning cloud architecture, networking, platform engineering, infrastructure operations, automation, and security.
Demonstrated ability to engage in architecture reviews, challenge technical design decisions, and influence engineering standards through technical expertise and credibility.
Experience leading organizations responsible for cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, architecture, operations, and reliability.
Proven success developing and leading senior technology leaders, including Senior Managers, Directors, and Architects.
Extensive experience driving results through influence across business, security, engineering, and executive stakeholder groups.
Expertise in cloud-native architectures, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu), automation, DevOps, observability, resiliency engineering, and modern operating models.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management practices within large enterprise environments.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.
Proven ability to simultaneously lead strategic planning and execution across multiple complex initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building or enabling AI/ML infrastructure, advanced analytics platforms, or high-performance computing environments.
Experience supporting research, scientific computing, or large-scale data science workloads.
Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, healthcare, or other highly regulated industry experience.
Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, or Business Administration.
Industry certifications in cloud architecture, engineering, security, or infrastructure platforms.
Experience leading global organizations across multiple regions, cultures, and time zones.
Experience with enterprise-scale migrations, data center exits, platform modernization initiatives, or mergers and acquisitions.
Demonstrated success driving technology transformation through both strategic vision and deep technical leadership.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a technology strategist and engineer at heart. They have built credibility through hands-on technical leadership, can engage deeply in architectural discussions, and have successfully led large-scale transformation efforts that delivered measurable business value. They are equally effective influencing executive stakeholders, mentoring technical leaders, and driving execution across complex enterprise environments.

Most importantly, this leader brings both the strategic mindset to shape Pfizer's future and the technical depth to help build it.

Other Job Details

Last day to apply: 9/7/2026
Work location assignment: Hybrid - onsite at NY Headquarters an average of 2.5 days per week or as the business requires
10-20% Travel

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $214,900.00 to $358,100.00. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 22.5% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits | (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. jobs.title: Head of Immunodiagnostics and Next Generation Technology
jobs.description:
Position Summary

As a Senior Leader within our Vaccines R&D Clinical Immunology and Diagnostics organization, you will envision and implement next-generation immunodiagnostics strategies. Reporting to the Head of Clinical Diagnostics, you will drive novel, high-throughput ligand binding assay (LBA) strategies outside of conventional plate-based assays—focusing heavily on automation, speed, and high precision.

You will lead a high-performing team developing and maintaining immunodiagnostic assays to support vaccine clinical trials and epidemiological studies. You will serve as the primary immunology and assay development Subject Matter Expert (SME) for vaccine program teams. You will leverage your deep end-to-end expertise in assay lifecycles, robotic sample handling, clinical batching, and analytical/clinical validations under GCLP/cGMP guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Innovation

Envision and execute next-generation ligand binding assay (LBA) strategies, driving high-throughput, automated, and rapid-completion alternatives to traditional plate-based assays.
Keep abreast of scientific and technological breakthroughs; identify and in-license/in-house promising new diagnostic platforms.

Project and Clinical Leadership

Set objectives for and manage multiple assay development projects (serological, immunodiagnostic, and toxicological).
Drive the prioritization of clinical epidemiological studies by optimizing logistical testing resources.
Author and review high-level technical documents, validations, regulatory responses, and scientific publications.

Collaboration and Influence

Collaborate across internal Vaccines R&D teams and external partners to integrate cutting-edge testing technologies into clinical strategies.
Lead technology transfers and represent the department in key scientific and strategic discussions.

People Management and Compliance

Direct and mentor a diverse team of scientists, including direct management of multiple subordinate managers.
Ensure all laboratory work and clinical testing strictly adhere to Pfizer values, SOPs, and GCLP/cGMP standards.

Minimum Qualifications

Education and Experience

PhD in Immunology or a closely related biological field.
5+ years of industry experience leading the development of advanced tools and assays and the implementation of cutting edge technologies
Experience managing other managers and mentoring junior scientists.

Technical Expertise

Deep expertise in assay development and lifecycle management (from concept/design to long-term sustainability).
Strong background in robotic sample handling systems, clinical batching, Design of Experiments (DoE), and general biostatistical analysis.
Expert knowledge of analytical/clinical validations under GCLP and/or cGMP guidelines.

Tools and Technology

Proficiency with LIMS, DoE software, and standard enterprise suites.

Communication and Influence

Strong publication record (primary author) and
Experience presenting concise, high-level data to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience leveraging AI, machine learning, or advanced algorithmic scheduling software to optimize high-throughput laboratory automation and automated assay data analysis pipelines
Experience interacting with/responding to regulatory agencies

Candidate demonstrates a breadth of diverse leadership experiences and capabilities including: the ability to influence and collaborate with peers, develop and coach others, oversee and guide the work of other colleagues to achieve meaningful outcomes and create business impact.

Work Location Assignment:
This is a hybrid role requiring you to live within commuting distance and work on-site an average of 2.5 days per week or more as needed.

Physical/Mental Requirements

Sitting of long periods of time and occasional walking from one building to another.

Relocation support available

The annual base salary for this position ranges from $176,600.00 to $294,300.00. Job Title

Executive Vice President of Technology

Detailed Job Description

Job Overview

The Executive Vice President of Technology is responsible for leading the company’s global technology strategy, engineering organization, technology operations, digital innovation, and enterprise architecture. This executive role oversees the development, implementation, and optimization of technology platforms that support business growth, product innovation, operational excellence, and long-term competitiveness.

The EVP of Technology serves as a key member of the executive leadership team, driving enterprise-wide technology transformation while ensuring alignment between technology investments, business strategy, product development, cybersecurity, and digital innovation. This role collaborates closely with Product Management, R&D, Operations, Commercial, and Corporate Strategy teams to accelerate innovation and deliver scalable technology solutions.

Key Responsibilities
I. Technology Strategy and Executive Leadership

Develop and execute the company's global technology strategy aligned with corporate vision and long-term business objectives.
Define enterprise technology roadmaps covering software, hardware, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, AI, and digital platforms.
Provide strategic technology leadership to support business growth, operational excellence, and competitive differentiation.
Advise the CEO and executive leadership team on emerging technologies, technology investments, and innovation opportunities.

II. Technology Development and Engineering Management

Lead global software engineering, systems engineering, platform development, infrastructure engineering, and technical operations teams.
Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and lifecycle management of enterprise technology solutions.
Establish engineering standards, development methodologies, architecture governance, and quality assurance processes.
Promote Agile, DevOps, DevSecOps, and continuous delivery best practices.

III. Digital Transformation and Innovation

Lead enterprise digital transformation initiatives across business functions.
Drive adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning (ML), Cloud Computing, Internet of Things (IoT), automation, big data analytics, and emerging technologies.
Identify new technology opportunities that enhance customer experience, operational efficiency, and business performance.
Foster a culture of continuous innovation and technology excellence.

IV. Enterprise Architecture and Technology Operations

Develop enterprise architecture strategies that ensure scalability, security, and interoperability across technology ecosystems.
Oversee IT infrastructure, cloud platforms, enterprise applications, data platforms, and technology operations.
Ensure technology systems maintain high availability, reliability, performance, and business continuity.
Optimize technology governance, system integration, and infrastructure utilization.

V. Cybersecurity, Compliance, and Risk Management

Develop enterprise cybersecurity strategies and information security governance frameworks.
Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, and data privacy regulations.
Establish technology risk management, disaster recovery, and business continuity plans.
Continuously monitor cybersecurity threats and implement proactive mitigation strategies.

VI. Technology Performance and Financial Management

Develop and manage the global technology budget, capital investments, and operational expenditures.
Optimize technology investments to maximize business value and return on investment (ROI).
Establish technology performance metrics, engineering KPIs, system reliability indicators, and operational dashboards.
Drive continuous improvement in technology efficiency, productivity, and cost management.

VII. Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner closely with Product Management, R&D, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, and Customer Support teams.
Ensure technology strategy supports product innovation, commercialization, customer success, and operational objectives.
Support mergers, acquisitions, system integrations, and global expansion initiatives.
Promote enterprise-wide collaboration to accelerate innovation and strategic execution.

VIII. Leadership and Organizational Development

Build and lead a world-class global technology organization.
Develop leadership capabilities, succession planning, and technical talent development programs.
Establish engineering excellence, technology governance, and organizational best practices.
Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, diversity, and continuous learning.

Qualifications
Education Background

Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related fields.
Master's degree or MBA preferred.

Work Experience

Typically 18+ years of experience in technology leadership, software engineering, information technology, systems architecture, or digital transformation, including 10+ years in executive management positions.

Proven track record of leading large-scale global technology organizations and delivering enterprise technology transformation.

Strong experience in software development, cloud computing, AI, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and digital innovation.

Experience in multinational corporations within healthcare, medical devices, life sciences, biotechnology, SaaS, enterprise software, technology, or advanced manufacturing industries preferred.

About Re:Build

At Re:Build, our mission is to ensure the next generation of important products are made, at scale, in America. We are laying the foundation for a better future for our customers, employees, and communities by revitalizing America's manufacturing base and creating meaningful jobs across the country, including in historically deindustrialized regions.

We operate an advanced, end-to-end manufacturing platform that partners with industrial companies and innovators to take products from first concept to full-scale production in critical verticals including aerospace and defense, electrification, medical, energy and environment, and robotics and automation.

We hire builders. If you need a fully-scoped plan before you'll move, this isn't the role. We need leaders who turn ambiguity into action, stay close to the work, and build the systems that make scale possible — fast.

The way we operate is as important as the work we do. It's guided by The Re:Build Way, 16 principles that shape how we collaborate with each other, partner with our customers and vendors, and contribute to the communities where we operate. (link to The Re:Build Way principles )

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for an experienced technology leader to own the development, launch, and scale-up of a new venture-scale opportunity in the CAM space. The right candidate will have demonstrated experience commercializing novel technology coming out of a research group, end-to-end. You are startup oriented, with experience shipping MVPs and then scaling them to thousands of users. The ideal candidate will have experience or strong familiarity with CAD/CAM space or in a tangential field using 3D modeling, simulation, and spatial data. You have excellent communication and conflict resolution skills. You are hungry and willing to roll up the sleeves and build with a talented cross-functional team.

What You Get To Do

Define the technology architecture required to bring a novel CAM product to market
Develop and implement a technology transfer strategy, from R&D to final product
Manage all elements of the software development process
Directly manage a team of software development engineers
Work closely with stakeholders to align product vision and commercial targets with an engineered solution
Partner with the GM and executive stakeholders to build a new venture-scale business

What You Bring To The Team

15+ years leading the development of highly technical engineered software products
A master's degree in a STEM discipline, or equivalent experience
Strong full stack fundamentals (you can meaningfully review a hard MR)
Bonus points for some familiarity with C++
Advanced knowledge of modern architecture and trends
Advanced knowledge of AI tooling, applications, and trends
Ability to lead, grow and motivate a team
Excellent executive communication and conflict resolution skills
Prior experience in CAD/CAM or a related 3D space
Strong desire to build a venture scale business with a small team over the next several years

The BIG payoff

We are a company who is going to make a difference in the industries and the communities in which we choose to operate.

Every employee of Re:Build will share ownership in the company and will share in the financial rewards of the success we achieve together, at all levels of the company!

We want to work with people that reflect the communities in which we operate

Use Your Power for Purpose

At the heart of Pfizer's Digital transformation sits Infrastructure & Cloud, enabling modern cloud platforms and engineering capabilities that accelerate scientific discovery, empower researchers, and improve patient outcomes worldwide.

Pfizer is seeking a highly accomplished technology leader who combines enterprise-scale strategic thinking with deep technical expertise in cloud, infrastructure, networking, and platform engineering. This role will shape the future of Pfizer's cloud and infrastructure ecosystem, enabling AI/ML-powered research, advanced analytics, and next-generation digital capabilities that support breakthrough science and drug discovery.

The successful candidate will be equally comfortable discussing business strategy with executive leadership, guiding large-scale transformation initiatives, and engaging directly with architects and engineers on critical technical decisions. This is a leadership role for someone who has not only led transformation programs but has personally helped design, build, and scale modern cloud platforms and infrastructure capabilities.

At Pfizer, your work will directly contribute to the technologies that enable scientists to accelerate research, unlock insights from complex data, and develop innovative medicines for patients around the world.

Pfizer seeks individuals who are highly self-motivated, intellectually curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning and growth.

What You Will Achieve

The Senior Director, Cloud & Infrastructure Transformation serves as both a strategic technology executive and a technical thought leader for Pfizer's cloud and infrastructure landscape. This leader will define future-state infrastructure strategy while ensuring the successful execution of complex, enterprise-scale initiatives spanning cloud, networking, data center modernization, platform engineering, and AI infrastructure.

You will lead a team of senior leaders, architects, and engineering organizations while helping establish the technology vision, engineering standards, and operating models required to support Pfizer's digital future.

You will be expected to drive business outcomes through technology strategy while maintaining the technical depth and credibility necessary to guide architecture decisions, challenge assumptions, and ensure engineering excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Define and execute Pfizer's multi-year cloud and infrastructure transformation strategy, aligning technology investments with business and scientific priorities.

Influencing executive leaders, peers, and technical teams to achieve enterprise outcomes.

Leading through ambiguity and driving execution in highly complex environments.
Translating technology strategy into measurable business impact.
Establishing credibility with both senior executives and highly technical engineering teams.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or related discipline.
12+ years of progressive leadership experience in cloud, infrastructure, networking, platform engineering, or related technology functions.
Demonstrated success leading large-scale cloud and infrastructure transformation programs at enterprise scale.
Deep expertise in public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, and/or GCP), with a proven history of designing, building, and operating production environments supporting critical business workloads.
Strong technical foundation spanning cloud architecture, networking, platform engineering, infrastructure operations, automation, and security.

Experience leading organizations responsible for cloud engineering, platform engineering, infrastructure automation, architecture, operations, and reliability.

Extensive experience driving results through influence across business, security, engineering, and executive stakeholder groups.
Expertise in cloud-native architectures, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/OpenTofu), automation, DevOps, observability, resiliency engineering, and modern operating models.
Strong understanding of cybersecurity, compliance, and risk management practices within large enterprise environments.
Exceptional communication skills with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into business-focused recommendations.
Proven ability to simultaneously lead strategic planning and execution across multiple complex initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

As a Senior Leader within our Vaccines R&D Clinical Immunology and Diagnostics organization, you will envision and implement next-generation immunodiagnostics strategies. You will lead a high-performing team developing and maintaining immunodiagnostic assays to support vaccine clinical trials and epidemiological studies.
